title: Berland Miners
statementMd:
The biggest gold mine in Berland consists of $*n*$ caves, connected by $*n* - 1$ transitions. The entrance to the mine leads to the cave number $1$, it is possible to go from it to any remaining cave of the mine by moving along the transitions.

The mine is being developed by the InMine Inc., $*k*$ miners work for it. Each day the corporation sorts miners into caves so that each cave has at most one miner working there.

For each cave we know the height of its ceiling $*h*_{*i*}$ in meters, and for each miner we know his height $*s*_{*j*}$, also in meters. If a miner's height doesn't exceed the height of the cave ceiling where he is, then he can stand there comfortably, otherwise, he has to stoop and that makes him unhappy.

Unfortunately, miners typically go on strike in Berland, so InMine makes all the possible effort to make miners happy about their work conditions. To ensure that no miner goes on strike, you need make sure that no miner has to stoop at any moment on his way from the entrance to the mine to his cave (in particular, he must be able to stand comfortably in the cave where he works).

To reach this goal, you can choose exactly one cave and increase the height of its ceiling by several meters. However enlarging a cave is an expensive and complex procedure. That's why InMine Inc. asks you either to determine the minimum number of meters you should raise the ceiling of some cave so that it is be possible to sort the miners into the caves and keep all miners happy with their working conditions or to determine that it is impossible to achieve by raising ceiling in exactly one cave.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{5}$) — the number of caves in the mine.

Then follows a line consisting of $*n*$ positive integers $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*h*_{*i*}$ is the height of the ceiling in the $*i*$-th cave.

Next $*n* - 1$ lines contain the descriptions of transitions between the caves. Each line has the form $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ are the numbers of the caves connected by a path.

The next line contains integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$).

The last line contains $*k*$ integers $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*s*_{*j*}$ is the $*j*$-th miner's height.

## Output

In the single line print the minimum number of meters that you need to raise the ceiling by in some cave so that all miners could be sorted into caves and be happy about the work conditions. If it is impossible to do, print $- 1$. If it is initially possible and there's no need to raise any ceiling, print $0$.

## Note

In the first sample test we should increase ceiling height in the first cave from $5$ to $11$. After that we can distribute miners as following (first goes index of a miner, then index of a cave): ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d9b256bdaa3f5b0f9a3fc3b9f56256306a7a570.png).

In the second sample test there is no need to do anything since it is already possible to distribute miners as following: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ba4a2592a4bea5feafeae1ab8dec98663bf2c557.png).

In the third sample test it is impossible.
statementZhMd:
Berland 最大的金矿由 $*n*$ 个洞穴组成，这些洞穴之间由 $*n* - 1$ 条通道连接。矿井入口通向编号为 $1$ 的洞穴，从该洞穴出发，沿着通道可以到达矿井中的任意其他洞穴。

InMine 公司正在开采这座矿井，共有 $*k*$ 名矿工为其工作。每天，公司都会将矿工分配到各个洞穴中，使得每个洞穴中最多有一名矿工工作。

我们知道每个洞穴的天花板高度 $*h*_{*i*}$（单位：米），也知道每名矿工的身高 $*s*_{*j*}$（单位：米）。如果矿工的身高不超过其所在洞穴的天花板高度，那么他可以舒适地站在那里；否则，他就必须弯腰，这会使他感到不高兴。

遗憾的是，矿工们在 Berland 经常罢工，因此 InMine 公司竭尽全力改善矿工的工作条件。为了确保没有矿工罢工，你需要保证从矿井入口前往其工作洞穴的途中，任何时刻都没有矿工需要弯腰（特别地，他必须能够在工作的洞穴中舒适地站立）。

为了达到这一目标，你可以选择一个洞穴，将其天花板高度增加若干米。然而，扩建洞穴是一项昂贵且复杂的工程。因此，InMine 公司希望你确定：为了能够将矿工分配到各个洞穴，并使所有矿工都对工作条件感到满意，需要将某个洞穴的天花板至少提高多少米；或者判断仅通过提高一个洞穴的天花板是否无法实现这一目标。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{5}$）——矿井中洞穴的数量。

接下来一行包含 $*n*$ 个正整数 $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*h*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个洞穴的天花板高度。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行描述洞穴之间的通道。每行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示编号为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$ 的两个洞穴之间由一条通道连接。

下一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）。

最后一行包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*s*_{*j*}$ 表示第 $*j*$ 名矿工的身高。

## 输出格式

在单独一行中输出：为了能够将所有矿工分配到洞穴中，并使他们都对工作条件感到满意，需要将某个洞穴的天花板提高的最小米数。如果无法做到，输出 $- 1$。如果初始状态下已经可以完成分配且无需提高任何天花板，输出 $0$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，我们应将第一个洞穴的天花板高度从 $5$ 提高到 $11$。之后可以按如下方式分配矿工（先给出矿工编号，再给出洞穴编号）：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d9b256bdaa3f5b0f9a3fc3b9f56256306a7a570.png)

在第二个样例中无需进行任何操作，因为已经可以按如下方式完成分配：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ba4a2592a4bea5feafeae1ab8dec98663bf2c557.png)

在第三个样例中，这是不可能实现的。
